description: OBR Policy measures database: original-scorecard tax and spending rows; local harvest verified byte-identical to the checked-in gzip copy.

publication.title: Policy measures database (November 2025)
publication.units_note: All figures in GBP million; Treasury costings rounded to nearest GBP 5m (GBP 1m since Budget 2018)
publication.sign_convention: positive = gain to the Exchequer (reduces borrowing); verbatim from Notes sheet

source_row_identity: 1-based line in uncompressed claims_path plus sha256 of the verbatim UTF-8 row
harvest_note: Spending rows use proposed_metric=exchequer_impact; tax rows use metric=revenue_change. Both signs are positive_gain_to_exchequer. Raw rows and original values are retained in the checked-in harvest; registries contain traceable normalized pointers.
